## Physical properties

| Boiling point | No compound-specific value was experimentally measured at 1 atm; the estimate remains unresolved [^1] |
| Vapor pressure | Not directly measured; no compound-specific curve located; unresolved |
| Thermal decomposition | In the cited GC-injector study at 300 °C, partial loss was observed over the stated residence time; this is not a universal sample threshold [^1] |

## Thermal-extraction context

The thermodynamic boiling point of the pure compound is not a device setpoint or a sample temperature. Evaporation from plant matrix is load- and device-dependent; the sample temperature remains unresolved.

[^1]: Primary thermal study, conditions stated in the source.
